description: Progress completion, language-neutral: for a state from initialState({ value, min, max }) in core/src/progress/state.ts, percentage(state) is the completed share, 0 to 100, compared to within 1e-9. min defaults to 0 and max to 100. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

percentages.name: A value in the default range
A value above the maximum counts as done
A value below the minimum counts as nothing
Steps out of a smaller maximum
A range that does not start at zero
An empty range reads as nothing done
